title: OCaml Temporal native client query request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge. The request names one exact workflow run or, with an empty run_id, the current run and one output-only query. The first public API sends an empty input array; the array remains explicit so a future typed-input query extension can preserve Temporal's normal WorkflowQuery shape.

run_id.description: Exact run ID, or the empty string to select the workflow's current run, which Temporal resolves when it handles the request (#791).

rpc_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller deadline for this RPC in milliseconds (#499), covering Core's transport retries. It replaces the operation's default budget, bounds only the client call, and never affects the workflow. Omitted means the default.
